verdict.rationale: Any SaaS vendor could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to a company-formation platform like Firstbase. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, and no evidence shows agent-oriented documentation. 'Registered agent' refers to a legal service, not AI agents, and a bare 'Advanced API integrations' pricing line is not agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
